title: The polar parametrization of an orthonormal pair pulls μHE[2]-null sets back to Lebesgue-null sets
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, a, e ∈ ℝ^P with |a| = |e| = 1 and ⟨a, e⟩ = 0, and let N ⊆ ℝ^P be an arbitrary set with μHE[2](N) = 0. Then for Lebesgue-almost every p = (t, α) ∈ ℝ × ℝ: if t > 0 and −π < α < π, then t(cos α·a + sin α·e) ∉ N.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (a e : Euclid P) (N : Set (Euclid P)), ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → μHE[2] N = 0 → ∀ᵐ p : ℝ × ℝ, 0 < p.1 → -Real.pi < p.2 → p.2 < Real.pi → p.1 • (Real.cos p.2 • a + Real.sin p.2 • e) ∉ N
